value.name: Asha agrees to the meeting
value.description: After a brief pause, Asha accepts the proposed arrangement and agrees to proceed.
evidence: He picked up his pen. He clicked it twice. "Fine," he said. "When."
"Tomorrow morning. Ten o'clock. I'll bring a paralegal. Rosa, can you be here?"

value.name: Asha requests a house walkthrough
value.description: Asha closes the portfolio and asks to walk through the house that afternoon to orient herself.
evidence: Asha closed the portfolio without putting anything into it.
"I'd like a few minutes to walk through the house this afternoon, if no one objects. Just to orient myself."

value.name: Daniel offers to guide Asha
value.description: Daniel quickly volunteers to show Asha around the house.
evidence: "I'll show you around," Daniel said quickly.

value.name: Asha prefers Rosa as guide
value.description: Asha declines Daniel's offer and says she would rather have Rosa show her the rooms.
evidence: "Thank you, but I'd prefer Rosa, since she knows the rooms."

value.name: Daniel leaves the house
value.description: Daniel gathers his belongings carefully, announces a noon call, and exits the house.
evidence: He stood. He gathered his pad and his pen and his phone and his keys with the careful economy of a man who did not want to be seen rushing, and he said, "I have a call at noon. I'll see you tomorrow," and he left through the pocket doors and a moment later the front door opened and closed and the brass clapper rang once, faintly, in sympathy.

value.name: Lucia breaks down in apology
value.description: After Daniel leaves, Lucia exhales heavily, covers her face, and apologizes for not staying calm.
evidence: Lucia exhaled. It was a long exhale, and at the end of it she put her face in her hands and pressed her palms hard against her eyes.
"I'm sorry," she said into her hands. "I'm sorry. I shouldn't have — I told myself I was going to be calm."

value.name: Asha reassures Lucia
value.description: Asha tells Lucia that she was calm and that Daniel was the one struggling to hide his feelings.
evidence: "You were calmer than he was. He just had more practice hiding it."

value.name: Asha questions Lucia privately
value.description: Asha waits a moment and then asks Lucia if she has anything to say without Daniel present.
evidence: Asha let a moment pass. "Lucia. Is there anything you want to tell me without your brother in the room."

value.name: Lucia turns to Rosa
value.description: Lucia lowers her hands, regains composure, and looks to Rosa as if seeking support or confirmation.
evidence: Lucia took her hands away from her face. Her eyes were dry but the skin around them had gone pink. She looked at Rosa.
